test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Seven persons, A, B, C, D, E, F, G, are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre.

1) C is the neighbour of A and G.

2) B is to the immediate right of A.

3) F is second to the left of D.

What is G's position?

options.text: To the immediate left of D
Second to the right of F
Second to the left of B

solution: Seven persons: A, B, C, D, E, F and G. 1) B is to the immediate right of A. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e2734c0a098f7d8873dfe47a0662bd309ba75372f39ae3f4352fbf1a87c3f37.png] 2) C is the neighbour of A and G.
